column1: # Where a threshold DECISION is actually taken. One row per DECISION SITE, not
# per rule: the first edition of this table gave one row per rule and hid three
# facts at once — LongParameterListRule takes three decisions, the five
# hierarchical rules take one per level, and a package split keyed on "rules"
# therefore put the same file in two packages. Review round 1 (comprehensive,
# codex, qwen — all three independently) rejected the plan on that.
# This is not enumeration-threshold-decision-shapes.tsv. That table classifies
# the 27 options classes by the decision they OFFER, and stays correct about it.
# This one locates every place the decision is TAKEN, which is what Ш7 replaces.
#   For every src/**/*Rule.php that is neither Abstract* nor an interface, scan
#   the rule class and — when it extends a base other than AbstractRule — that
#   base too, line by line, for:
#   A rule with no such line gets one `decides-in-rule` row and no line number.
#   Lines declaring a function, and lines starting a docblock, are skipped.
#   Options class: the first `XOptions::class` literal in the same scope.
# WHAT THIS METHOD DOES NOT SEE
# - AbstractRule is deliberately outside the walk: its own `->getSeverity()`
#   lives inside getEffectiveSeverity(), so including it marks all 45 rules as
#   asking. An earlier pass that did include it reported 45/45; one that ignored
#   inheritance entirely called the three type-coverage rules inline deciders,
#   though AbstractTypeCoverageRule asks for them. Both looked finished.
# - A decision expressed through an accessor named none of the four above.
#   getVoSeverity was found only because a reviewer read the rule; a fifth such
#   name would be missed the same way.
# - Traits, and a decision delegated to a collaborator rather than a base class.
# - Whether a rule's inline comparison agrees with its options class. It does not
#   for InheritanceRule, whose docblock says it mirrors the options by hand.
#   21 rules carry no threshold (18 decide in the rule, 3 call the helper) —
#   24 rules carry one: 29 sites. 2 take the sanctioned one-call path, 21 read
#      the options accessor after resolving effective options, 1 reads the raw
#      override map (LongParameterListRule's VO path, which bypasses
#      getEffectiveOptions entirely), 1 is that path's getVoSeverity, and 4
#   4 rules hold more than one site: LongParameterListRule (3), and
#      one per level). A package split must be keyed on files, not on this count.
